ns2:course.label: Project Management
ns2:course.description: Focuses on project management methodology that will allow you to initiate and manage projects efficiently and effectively. You will learn key project management skills and strategies, and you will have the opportunity to apply this knowledge through assignments.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Information Sciences department.
